column1: # Label cleaning, layer 1: pure spelling-variant groups (cleaning plan "Layer 1"; training/cleaning.py).
# "canonical<TAB>variant[<TAB>...]": the members are the same word in every context; every variant becomes the
# canonical (first) form. Matched case-insensitively on whole tokens, longest first. The canonical form is the one
# T* writes most often across all kept labels (case-insensitive count per form, in T*'s most frequent casing), ties
# to the term list's first form (cleaning plan v4). Groups from the committed term lists' spelling variants
# (terms.variant_key), plus ok / okay and alright / all right. Contextual groups (back end / backend, front end /
# frontend) are layer 2 sets in choices.tsv.
# Disabled by the net-harm check (cleaning plan Check 3, on the human-reference labels): all right, cybersecurity, okay
